figurative_meaning_en: A young man with immature intellect, considered insignificant or foolish
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো এখনও ছোকরা, এত বড় সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবে না।
এই ছোকরারা শুধু বাজে কথা বলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He's still just a chokra; he can't make such big decisions yet.
These young whippersnappers only talk nonsense.
note: Derived from Hindi/Urdu 'chokra', commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to belittle young men.
